mod.name: Automated Buildings (abandoned)
mod.description:
Abandoned experiment in automating crew-required Space Haven facilities via pure XML.
This mod is empty as of v0.5.0. See README.md for the post-mortem on what was tried and why it doesn't work.
TL;DR: Vanilla Space Haven hardcodes crew interaction for the Optronics Fabricator, Advanced Assembler, and Grow Bed. XML flags like `autoproduce="true"` and `produceInNormal="true"` are not enough to bypass the Java-side gate — the production tick never fires without a crew member completing the work loop. Real automation here requires AspectJ code injection (the same conclusion drones_plus Phase 2 reached).
The repo is kept as a documented dead-end so future modders don't redo the experiment from scratch.
mod.author: mingc
